title: A webhook times out, comes again, and the event id stops double work
captions: The sender posts an invoice.paid event to your endpoint. The event has an id, evt_42, and a signature.

Your endpoint checks the signature and does the work inline. It takes 12 seconds. When it finishes, it saves evt_42 as seen. This is the slow pattern from step 3. It shows why the id check still matters.
The sender stopped waiting before your answer came. It marks the delivery as failed. It cannot know that the work happened.
After a backoff, the sender tries again. The body has the same event id, evt_42. With Stripe, the timestamp and signature are new.
Your endpoint finds evt_42 in the seen list. It answers 200 and skips the work. The invoice is marked paid once.
